notes.uz: Lenta: Umumiy (Kutubxona, Avto o'lcham, Tartiblash, Eksport) va Ko'rinish (Qirqim, Mebel) panellari. Pardoz menyusi: Pol, Shift, Devor, Pardoz. Xona chegarasi sozlamasi Devor oynasida (standart o'chiq). Revitni yopmasdan yangilashning birinchi sinovi.

notes.en: Ribbon: General and Views panels. Finish menu renamed. Room bounding moved to Walls window. First update without restarting Revit.
